page.content:
Murder, mourning, and Horus' lawsuit against Set.

How Osiris myth connects

  • Character: Osiris — The Osiris myth is the murder and restoration of Osiris.
  • Character: Horus — The myth ends in Horus' claim to the living throne.

What is Osiris myth?

The Osiris myth is the succession drama of Egyptian religion: Set's crime, Isis' search, Horus' childhood in the marshes, and the divine tribunal that restores kingship.

Key threads lead to Osiris and Horus.
